title: 第13章 不对我负责？
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
姜怀玉脸颊发烫，却不是因为害羞，而是因为羞耻。

    她一个金丹九重的修士，曾经的天之骄女，竟然在不知不觉间，对一个筑基期的师弟产生了依赖，甚至……甚至开始期待些什么。

    而人家，只想着负责女儿，压根没想过负责她。

    “你……是不是要赶我走？”她开口，声音比平时冷了几分。

    陆沉连忙否认：“不是，师姐，我没那个意思……”

    “那你是什么意思？口口声声说不能走得太近，要保持距离，不就是想让我搬走吗？”

    “我真没那个意思！”陆沉急了。

    “我只是觉得，咱们应该……”

    “应该什么？”

    “应该保持距离。”

    姜怀玉沉默了。

    她看着陆沉，心里忽然涌起一股没来由的生气。

    保持距离？她这些天对他那么好，给他做不重样的美食，给他收拾洞府，等他出关，给他庆祝！

    他倒好，林天和庄静白来了一趟，就想赶她走？

    怎么，她就这么没有魅力吗？你陆沉就这么嫌弃我？

    她姜怀玉，玄天宗公认的仙子，曾经无数男修仰慕的对象，如今主动住进一个男人的洞府，给他洗衣做饭，他居然要和她保持距离？

    今天，她非要唱这个反调！

    “师姐？”

    陆沉见她沉默，以为她同意了，正要松口气时，姜怀玉却忽然往前迈了一步。

    陆沉下意识后退。

    姜怀玉又往前一步。

    陆沉再退。

    “师姐，你……”

    姜怀玉不说话，只是盯着他，一步一步往前走。

    陆沉退到墙边，退无可退。

    姜怀玉在他面前停下，仰头看着他。

    两人离得很近，近到陆沉能看清她睫毛的弧度，能闻到她身上淡淡的兰花香。

    “师姐，你这是……”

    “你不是要保持距离吗？”姜怀玉看着他，眼底带着一丝挑衅。

    “那我偏不。”

    她说着，又往前贴了半步。

    陆沉整个人贴在墙上，僵得像块木头。

    他能感觉到她呼吸的频率，能感觉到她……

    “师姐……”他的声音都变了调。
content_en:
Jiang Huaiyu's cheeks were hot, not because of shyness, but because of shame.

She was a monk at the ninth level of the Golden Core, and was once the proud daughter of heaven. She had unknowingly become dependent on a junior brother who was in the Foundation Establishment stage, and even... even started to expect something.

As for me, I only thought about being responsible for my daughter, not her at all.

"You...are you going to drive me away?" She said, her voice a little colder than usual.

Lu Chen quickly denied: "No, senior sister, I didn't mean that..."

"Then what do you mean? You keep saying not to get too close and to keep your distance. Don't you just want me to move away?"

"I really don't mean that!" Lu Chen was anxious.

"I just think we should..."

"What should it be?"

"You should keep your distance."

Jiang Huaiyu fell silent.

She looked at Lu Chen, and suddenly there was an unreasonable anger in her heart.

Keep your distance?She has been so good to him these days, cooking him delicious food, cleaning up his cave, waiting for him to come out of seclusion, and celebrating for him!

It's good for him. Lin Tian and Zhuang Jingbai came here and wanted to drive her away?

Why, is she so unattractive?Do you, Lu Chen, dislike me so much?

She, Jiang Huaiyu, was a recognized fairy of the Xuantian Sect and was once the object of admiration for countless male cultivators. Now she took the initiative to live in a man's cave, wash and cook for him, and he actually wanted to keep a distance from her?

Today, she insisted on singing the opposite tune!

"Sister?"

Seeing her silence, Lu Chen thought she agreed. Just when he was about to breathe a sigh of relief, Jiang Huaiyu suddenly took a step forward.

Lu Chen retreated subconsciously.

Jiang Huaiyu took another step forward.

Lu Chen retreated again.

"Sister, you..."

Jiang Huaiyu didn't speak, just stared at him and walked forward step by step.

Lu Chen retreated to the wall, unable to retreat.

Jiang Huaiyu stopped in front of him and looked up at him.

The two were very close, so close that Lu Chen could clearly see the curve of her eyelashes and smell the faint fragrance of orchids on her body.

"Senior sister, what are you..."

"Don't you want to keep your distance?" Jiang Huaiyu looked at him with a hint of provocation in his eyes.

"Then I won't."

She said, taking another half step forward.

Lu Chen's whole body was pressed against the wall, as stiff as a piece of wood.

He could feel the frequency of her breathing, could feel her...

"Senior sister..." His voice changed its tone.
